verdict.summary_en: Boise Semiconductor order acknowledgement OA25717212 for Soony Interactive GmbH PO 4500318533 (2025-07-22). It has two lines for CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5, 9,000 each. Item 00020 is at 6.11 USD, confirmed 2025-09-01. Item 00010 is at 6.29 USD, confirmed 2025-08-21. Terms are EXW Boise, NET30. There are no handwritten corrections or stamps.
red_flags: The same material CMP-GAM-002 appears on two items with the same quantity (9,000) but different unit prices (6.11 vs 6.29 USD) and different confirmed dates (2025-09-01 vs 2025-08-21).
Item 00020 is listed before item 00010, so the lines are out of order.

The terms contradict each other: the document states EXW Boise and says DDP is not agreed, but also says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by the Seller and added to the invoice. That is not consistent with plain EXW.
The document has no date of its own. The only date is the customer order date, 2025-07-22.
No total price is stated, and no unit of measure is given for the quantities.
observations: Clean typed PDF with a single page.
No handwriting, stamps, signatures or strike-throughs visible.
The description wraps over three lines in each row but is fully legible.
